DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの二件をお振り込みですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to make these two transfers, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金額が同じ二枚ありますが、一方に再送と書いてあります。同じ請求かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二通の同額請求が再送の可能性だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two bills for the same amount, but one says it was resent. They may be the same bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the two bills for the same amount may include a resent copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 請求番号と支払先を見比べましょう。請求元への確認はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the invoice numbers and payees. Have you checked with the issuer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。番号は同じでした。二通来たから二回払うとは決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号が同じで二重支払いを未決定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. The numbers were the same. I haven't decided to pay twice just because two copies arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the numbers match and you have not decided to pay twice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ請求か、請求元へ確認してください。銀行だけで請求の件数は確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask the issuer whether they are the same bill. The bank alone cannot determine how many bills there are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は二件として振り込まず、同じ番号の再送だと伝えて聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 請求元確認まで二件の振込を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't transfer them as two payments now. I'll explain that they are resent copies with the same number and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put both transfers on hold until you check with the issuer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お支払い済みの記録もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have any record of having paid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先週払った可能性があります。自分の振込控えも確認してから、必要な額を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前の支払控えも照合したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I may have paid last week. I'll check my transfer receipt too, then discuss the amount that needs paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you also want to compare your earlier payment receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。請求の確認と支払記録の照合を先に進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Let's first check the bill and compare the payment records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二枚の案内を保管し、請求元の回答と前回の記録で未払いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求回答と取引記録から未払い分を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll keep both notices and use the issuer's reply and my previous record to check what is unpaid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the unpaid amount using the issuer's reply and transaction record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。本日の振込は保留にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will put today's transfers on hold.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの洗剤でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the detergent you would like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。すぐ使いたいです。中にポンプの容器も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 詰め替え袋に容器が含まれるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to use it right away. Does it include the pump bottle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the refill pouch includes a container. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは詰め替え用で、容器は入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a refill, so it does not include a container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家に容器がありません。袋の絵を実物のセットだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器がなく絵をセット内容と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't have a container at home. I thought the picture on the pouch showed the actual set included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no container and thought the picture showed the set's contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本体の容器入りを見比べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like to compare it with the version that comes in a bottle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。同じ商品の容器入りがあるか知りたいです。袋をそのまま立てて使うとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同商品本体を希望し袋使用を自己判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to know whether the same product comes in a bottle. I won't decide on my own to stand the pouch up and use it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the bottled version of the same product without deciding for yourself to use the pouch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが本体です。商品名と用途も同じか表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is the bottled version. Please check the label to make sure the product name and intended use are also the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認します。本体を買い、詰め替え袋は今回はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 商品表示を確認して本体へ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check. I'll buy the bottle and skip the refill pouch this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the product label and switch to the bottled version. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。詰め替え袋はスタッフが戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. A staff member will put the refill pouch back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。家で使う本体があるか確かめてから、次は詰め替えを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今後は容器の所持を確かめ詰め替えを買う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Next time, I'll check that I have the bottle to use at home before choosing a refill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check that you have a container before buying refills in future. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。本体の容器入りで会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll ring up the version that comes in a bottle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散水についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the sprinklers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 敷物がぬれそうです。近くの栓を閉めれば止まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散水を自分で止めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mat might get wet. Will closing the nearby valve stop the water?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may stop the sprinklers yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で設備を操作せず、散水する場所から離れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't operate the equipment yourself. Move away from the area being watered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。敷物と荷物を先に持って移ります。子どもも水の所から離します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 設備に触れず荷物と子どもを移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll take the mat and our bags and move first. I'll also move the children away from the water.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move your belongings and children without touching the equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。散水の範囲は担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. The person responsible will check the watering area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休める別の場所を教えてください。水が止まったと見てすぐ元へ戻るのでなく、案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停止だけで再利用せず別の休憩場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please show me another place to rest. Rather than going straight back when I see the water stop, I'd like to hear your instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about another rest area instead of returning just because the water stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では舗装側のベンチをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this situation, we can direct you to the bench on the paved side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ではベンチへ移ります。散水の向きがおかしいと感じた所も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 代替場所を選び気づいた散水方向も報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll move to the bench. I'll also tell you where I thought the water was spraying in an unusual direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose an alternative place and report the spray direction you noticed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路にも水が飛んでいました。ただ、故障かどうかは私には分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路への水を事実として伝え故障は断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Water was also spraying onto the walkway. However, I don't know whether it is a malfunction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the water on the walkway as a fact without concluding the equipment is faulty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通路への散水を担当者へ報告します。設備には触らず、ベンチでお休みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll report the watering of the walkway to the person responsible. Please rest on the bench without touching the equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: きっぷをお持ちではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you not have your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の券も妻の袋に入れました。妻は先に改札を通っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の券を先に通過した妻の袋へ入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put my ticket in my wife's bag too. She has already gone through the ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you put your ticket in the bag of your wife, who has already passed through. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の券を確認する必要があります。奥へ追いかけず、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check your own ticket. Please wait here rather than following her farther inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。妻の券を渡してもらって代わりに使うのでなく、私の券を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他人の券を代用せず本人の券を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I want to check my ticket, rather than have her hand me hers to use instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to check your own ticket without substituting someone else's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 奥の係員からご家族へ連絡できるか確認します。お名前は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether the staff inside can contact your family member. Do you know her name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 妻はリンです。二人分を別々に買ったので、私の券も袋にあるはずですが、まだ確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族の名前と未確認の券の所在を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My wife is Lin. We bought our two tickets separately, so mine should be in the bag too, but I haven't checked yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your family member's name and the unconfirmed location of your ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。お客様はこの場所で待ち、係員の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please wait here and follow the staff's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。妻も出入口を行き来せず、係員に袋の券を見せてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 双方が勝手に移動せず係員へ券を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. My wife won't go back and forth through the entrance either; I'll have her show the tickets in the bag to the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say both of you will avoid moving around on your own and show the tickets to staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に通過方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, we will explain how to pass through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。私の券があると確認できてから、案内に従って改札を通ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の券の確認後に案内された方法で通過する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Once my own ticket has been confirmed, I'll follow the instructions to pass through the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pass through as instructed after your own ticket is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご家族の持つ券を確認する係員へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll hand this over to the staff checking the tickets your family member has.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約案内を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you check your reservation confirmation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 保存したファイルが開きません。予約したことは覚えていますが、番号は読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存済み案内が開かず予約番号を確認できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The file I saved won't open. I remember making a reservation, but I can't read the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your saved confirmation won't open and you cannot check the reservation number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 完了時のメールなどは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have the email sent when the reservation was completed, for example?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールはあります。添付ファイルだけ開かず、本文の日時なら表示できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メール本文の日時は表示できると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the email. Only the attachment won't open; I can display the date and time in the email body.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can display the date and time in the email body. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その本文を見せてください。担当者が予約の記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show us that email body. The person responsible will check the reservation record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。番号を覚えたつもりで答えず、メールと自分の名前から確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号を推測せず記録による本人予約確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than answering with a number I only think I remember, I'd like you to check using the email and my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask staff to verify your own reservation from records without guessing the number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。ファイルが開かないことだけで、予約が取り消されたとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. A file failing to open does not necessarily mean the reservation was canceled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。受付の確認中に、新しい予約を重ねて取らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示不具合を取消しと決めず重複予約を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. While reception checks it, I'll avoid making another reservation on top of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid duplicate reservations without assuming the display problem means cancellation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な案内は担当者から改めてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will provide the necessary instructions again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。予約が確認できたら、持参物の案内も見られる形で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約確認後に持参物案内の再提示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Once the reservation is confirmed, please also give me the instructions on what to bring in a form I can view.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the instructions on what to bring again after the reservation is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。予約確認と案内の再提示を担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll pass the reservation check and request to display the instructions again to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査前の説明はもう受けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you already received the explanation before the examination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。先に時計と眼鏡を外しましたが、どこへ置けばいいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明前に装身具を外し保管に困ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I already removed my watch and glasses, but I don't know where to put them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you removed your accessories before the explanation and do not know where to store them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な準備と保管場所は担当者が案内します。机へ置いたまま離れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person responsible will explain the necessary preparations and storage location. Don't leave them on the desk and walk away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。眼鏡がないと案内が読めないので、外す時期も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 眼鏡がないと読めず外す時期も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I can't read the instructions without my glasses, so I'd also like to check when to remove them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot read without glasses and ask when to remove them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その希望を担当者へ伝えます。何を外すかも自己判断で決める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the person responsible about that request. You do not need to decide for yourself what to remove either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。検査に必要な物と、受付でまだ使う物を分けて説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要な準備とまだ使う物を自己判断せず確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll listen to the explanation distinguishing items needed for the examination from items I still use at reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the necessary preparations and items still in use without deciding for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち物はご自身で一つにまとめ、案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please gather your belongings together yourself and wait for instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋にまとめます。検査が終わった時に戻す物が分かるよう、今入れた物も覚えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち物をまとめ保管した物を把握する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put them in a bag. I'll also remember what I put in now so I know which items to put back on after the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Gather your belongings and keep track of what you have stored. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保管の方法と受け取りについて担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person responsible will explain how to store and collect them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。外す物と時期、保管場所を確認してから検査の準備をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外す物・時期・保管場所の説明後に準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll prepare for the examination after checking what to remove, when to remove it, and where to store it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare after receiving the explanation of what to remove, when, and where to store it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備と眼鏡の使用について担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll pass on the questions about preparation and using your glasses to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした傘は青い傘ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: The umbrella you lost is blue, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。青いのは今持っている代わりの傘です。なくした物は黒です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 代替傘の色を紛失物として話したと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. The blue one is the replacement umbrella I have now. The one I lost is black.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your description, explaining that you gave the replacement umbrella's color as the lost one's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の物と、探している物が違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the one you have now and the one you are looking for are different?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。持ち手も違います。黒い傘は木の持ち手で、こちらはプラスチックです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 探す傘の色と持ち手を現在の物から区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The handles are different too. The black umbrella has a wooden handle, and this one is plastic.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the missing umbrella's color and handle from those of your current umbrella. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 探す傘の特徴だけを記録しましょう。写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's record only the features of the umbrella you are looking for. Do you have a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古い写真があります。現在の青い傘の写真でなく、黒い方を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 探す物の写真だけを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an old photo. I'll show the black one, not a photo of the blue umbrella I have now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show only a photo of the item you are looking for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。なくした場所や時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. Please also tell us where and when you lost it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の駅ですが、正確な位置は分かりません。特徴は確かでも、場所は推測で埋めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確かな特徴と不確かな場所を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was at the station yesterday, but I don't know the exact spot. Although I'm sure of its features, I won't fill in the location by guessing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the features you know from the uncertain location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確かな特徴と、場所の分かる範囲を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll ask separately about the features you know and as much of the location as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。黒い木の持ち手の傘を探していると訂正し、今の傘は参考にしないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紛失物の情報を訂正し代替物は除外する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll correct the description to say I'm looking for a black umbrella with a wooden handle, and ask you not to use my current umbrella as a reference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Correct the lost item's information and exclude the replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。探す傘の情報を訂正して担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll correct the information about the umbrella you are looking for and hand it over to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの二通をお送りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send these two letters, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ送らないでください。母と兄への手紙を、逆の封筒へ入れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手紙と封筒が逆かもしれず発送を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please don't send them yet. I may have put the letters to my mother and older brother in each other's envelopes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Stop the mailing because the letters and envelopes may be switched. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身を確認してからお持ちいただけます。まだ受付前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can bring them back after checking the contents. We haven't accepted them yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。宛名だけ交換するのでなく、手紙の相手と封筒の宛先を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛名だけでなく本文の相手との一致を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Rather than simply swapping the addresses, I'll check that each letter's intended recipient matches the envelope's addressee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the match with the letter's intended recipient, not just the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでご自身が開けて確認できます。書類の置き忘れにもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can open them and check them yourself here. Please also be careful not to leave any papers behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けました。母への手紙が兄の封筒に入っていたので、正しい方へ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開封確認で誤りが見つかり正しい封筒へ移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've opened them. The letter to my mother was in my brother's envelope, so I'll move it to the correct one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you found the error after opening them and will move the letter to the right envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移した後、二通それぞれの中身を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After moving it, please check the contents of both letters separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。一通ずつ名前を見て入れ、閉じる前に宛先も照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一通ずつ中身と宛名を再照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll check the name and put each letter in one at a time, then compare the addresses too before sealing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare each letter's contents and addressee again, one at a time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒の状態も確認してから受付します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll accept them after checking the condition of the envelopes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 準備できました。母と兄の手紙が合い、封も整ったので、この二通を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封も整え確認済みの二通を発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: They're ready. The letters to my mother and brother match and the envelopes are properly sealed, so I'll send these two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send the two checked letters after putting their seals in order too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認済みの二通として受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will accept them as two checked letters.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 内容をご確認ください。よろしければ手続きを進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the details. If everything is correct, we will proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の名前のカタカナが違います。受取人に伝えた読みは「ハイン」で、ここは「ヘイン」です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 振込人名の読み違いを実行前に指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The katakana spelling of my name is wrong. I told the recipient it is pronounced “Hain,” but here it says “Hein.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the incorrect reading of the sender's name before the transfer is executed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実行前に表記を確認しましょう。お口座の登録表記も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the spelling before proceeding. We'll also check the spelling registered for your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。登録と今回の表示を勝手に同じように直すのでなく、違う所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 登録表記と今回表示の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. Rather than changing the registered spelling and this display to match on my own, I'd like you to tell me where they differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the difference between the registered spelling and the current display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な変更手続きを担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person responsible will explain the required change procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。受取人名ではなく、振込人である私の名前の相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 訂正対象は受取人でなく本人名義だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'm asking about my own name as the sender, not the recipient's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the correction concerns your own name, not the recipient's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、対象の欄を確認しました。今の振込はまだ実行していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we have confirmed the relevant field. This transfer has not been executed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。訂正できた内容を見てから、受取人へ知らせる名前もそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訂正表示に合わせ受取人への通知名もそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. After seeing the corrected details, I'll make the name I give the recipient match them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the name you notify the recipient of to the corrected display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示を確認後、実行のご希望を改めて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After you check the display, we will ask again whether you wish to proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の名義を確認し、受取人の口座情報はそのまま別に照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人名義と受取人口座情報を別に照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll check my own name and separately compare the recipient's account details as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your own name and the recipient's account details separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。振込人名の確認として担当者へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll direct you to the person responsible to check the sender's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 放送についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the announcement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の名前に似た言葉が聞こえました。呼び出されたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名前に似た放送が本人呼出しか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I heard something that sounded like my name. Was I being called?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the announcement sounding like your name was calling you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 直前の放送は商品の案内でした。お客様のお名前の呼び出しではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The announcement just now was product information. It was not calling your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。子どもとはぐれたわけでもなく、ただ放送を聞き違えたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 商品案内と分かり迷子相談ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I haven't become separated from my child either; I seem to have simply misheard the announcement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you understand it was product information and you are not asking about a lost child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お探しの方はいらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夫と別々に買い物しています。呼び出してもらうのでなく、決めたレジ前で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族呼出しでなく既定の場所で待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: My husband and I are shopping separately. Instead of asking for an announcement, I'll wait in front of the checkout we agreed on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to wait at the agreed place rather than have your family member called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。通路が空く位置でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. Please wait where you leave the aisle clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。放送を待ち合わせ変更と考えず、夫へ自分のいる場所をメッセージで伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 放送から予定変更を推測せず家族へ場所を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't take the announcement to mean our meeting plans have changed; I'll message my husband to tell him where I am.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your family member your location without inferring a plan change from the announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要なご案内があればスタッフへお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need any assistance, please ask a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。商品案内だったと分かったので、予定の場所で夫を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済みの案内に基づき元の待ち合わせを続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Now that I know it was product information, I'll wait for my husband at our planned meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Continue with the original meeting plan based on the confirmed announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。レジ前の待ち合わせ場所をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12222-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please use the meeting spot in front of the checkout.
